structured_output.summary: SharedDataMiddleware now serves files through send_file. It passes the file object, the name, an ETag built from mtime and size, last_modified and max_age=cache_timeout. HTTPExceptions such as 412 or 416 are returned as responses. cache_timeout now defaults to None. cache and fallback_mimetype default to None and warn with a DeprecationWarning when passed. fallback_mimetype is still honoured when the mimetype can't be guessed. I added middleware tests but couldn't run anything here, so none of it has been run.
